name: ... and that note you found

faq.answer: The charred, blistered note reads: “Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place.” It is the only clue left at the abandoned campsite.
faq.q: What does the note found at the campsite say?

aliases: where did the note come from
faq.answer: The note's author is unknown. It was found among scattered provisions beside the dying embers of a recent campfire, suggesting whoever wrote or carried it left recently or was forced to depart in haste.
The note's “twin land” means a matching or mirrored place. The charred fragment gives no further explanation, leaving its meaning for travelers to unravel.
faq.q: What does 'the twin land' refer to?

aliases: what to do with the note
faq.answer: The charred note is your only guide, with no destination marked on a map. Its riddle points you to seek a land or place that echoes its description.
faq.q: How do you follow the clues on the note?

faq.answer: The campsite shows signs of a sudden departure or disturbance. Scattered provisions lie beside fading embers, and no other identifying gear or signs remain beyond the blistered scrap.

aliases: does the fire reveal anything else
faq.answer: No other writings or markers remain intact at the campfire. The flames destroyed almost everything, leaving only the blistered paper as evidence of whoever rested there.
faq.q: Are there any other clues at the fire?

sections.body: A recent campfire is dying beside scattered provisions and a blistered piece of paper. Whoever stayed here left recently, and the parchment narrowly escaped the flames. The supplies remain exposed, as though the traveler departed in haste or was interrupted.
sections.title: Embers in the Wild

sections.body: The surviving scrap bears one instruction: “Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place.” No signature, coordinates, or further context survived the fire. The riddle is the only trail left for whoever finds it.
sections.title: A Cryptic Riddle

summary: At a recent campsite, cooling embers and scattered supplies are all that remain. A scorched parchment bears a riddle about finding a twin land, the only clue left behind.
attribution: In-game quest text: ... and that note you found
